title: Measurability of the approximate tangent projection of an integer multiplicity triple
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep U n: M ⊆ U is Borel and countably n-rectifiable; θ : ℝ^P → ℕ is measurable with θ ≥ 1 on M and ∫_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U; and, Hⁿ-a.e. on M, M has an approximate tangent plane oriented by ξ. Let p_x be the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x. This is the approximate tangent plane T_xM where one exists (Simon Ch. 3, 1.4), and {0} otherwise. Then x ↦ p_x is AEMeasurable from ℝ^P into L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P), with its Borel σ-algebra, with respect to μ_R = θHⁿ⌞M (R.measure).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → AEMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure
